name: bootstrap-projects
description: Create Kotlin Toolchain apps and implement features with a portable, resumable agent orchestrator.

interface.longDescription: Start Android and Kotlin Multiplatform development from a reviewed recipe. Choose Android, iOS, desktop JVM or browser Wasm; shared Compose or native SwiftUI; manual or Koin DI; navigation; Ktor networking, Settings storage and native mobile Firebase Analytics, Messaging and Remote Config. A portable Kotlin CLI, shipped as sources with a pinned Kotlin Toolchain wrapper, validates compatibility, previews files, generates reproducible projects and runs selected build/test checks. No Java installation is required; the first run provisions the Toolchain and reuses an installed Java 25+. iOS builds require macOS and full Xcode. SDK/dependency downloads require network access. Generation never overwrites existing projects. The orchestrate-feature skill implements changes in existing Kotlin Toolchain apps with dependency tasks, bounded attempts, durable recovery and source-bound test/review evidence. Managed subagents are used when available; unavailable independent review is reported. No MCP server or service account is required for generation. Optional Firebase connection uses an authenticated Firebase tool or CLI; Apple push needs APNs setup.
defaultPrompt: Start the step-by-step wizard to create a Kotlin app.
Help me choose platforms, UI and components for a new app.
Use orchestrate-feature to implement a feature in this existing Kotlin app.
